stem: Two drawn road segments cross, but no node or connecting edge is declared at that crossing. What should the graph search assume?

options.text: A transfer is available because intersecting line segments imply the same graph vertex
The search may insert a transfer at the crossing whenever doing so lowers its heuristic estimate
A transfer is available whenever both crossing roads are undirected
No transfer is available there unless the graph explicitly encodes one
